# ECON 262A - Topics in Labor Economics: Education, Discrimination, and Criminal Justice
## Spring 2026, Felipe Goncalves

This class covers program evaluation, instrumental variables, marginal treatment effects, and difference-in-differences design, as well as applications to papers in human capital and returns to education, neighborhood effects and peer effects, and the economics of crime. Please let me know at [kennyguo@ucla.edu](mailto:kennyguo@ucla.edu) if you spot any errors. Thanks!
